Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of the as-prepared five samples were analyzed to provide evidences of their crystal phases. The dominant diffraction peak of Cu(1)Sn(4)-N-CC becomes Cu6.25Sn5 (110) (JCPDS PDF# 47-1575), and Cu(1)Sn(4)-N-CC also exhibits the weaker intensity of Sn (220) and (221) planes, which can be deemed as the saturation of Sn2+ around growth substrate (CC).
